It has an office in every city.

clips.title: Explaining a Process
clips.script:
Customer Assistant: I need to process a returned item. What should I do first?
Supervisor: First, check the order number. Next, inspect the product and record its condition.
Customer Assistant: After that, I prepare the return label and give it to the customer, correct?
Supervisor: That’s right. Finally, update the inventory record before you close the request.
